about: Graphics reference library: how other editors DISPLAY information on screen, filed by the job the graphic does. Stills are steals for their system (layout, hierarchy, palette logic, motion), never for their exact design. Motion on a still is INFERRED; a clip in the entry makes it measured.

jobs.title: Process & steps
jobs.when: The speaker names a sequence, a framework or an acronym and walks through it.

jobs.title: Comparison
jobs.when: Old vs new, them vs us, before vs after, two paths.

jobs.title: Spectrum & position
jobs.when: Where something sits between two ends, or how far along a journey someone is.

jobs.title: Structure & breakdown
jobs.when: What something is made of: streams, parts, layers, a stack.

jobs.title: Who is speaking
jobs.when: Introducing a person: name, role, company.

jobs.title: Proof with photos
jobs.when: Real events, real people, real results the speaker refers to.

jobs.title: Range & audience
jobs.when: "Anyone can" / "all kinds of people": breadth of who it's for.

jobs.title: Labels over the speaker
jobs.when: Short terms the speaker lists, shown without leaving the speaker's face.

jobs.title: Beats & kinetic text
jobs.when: A pause, a question, a pivot line, a moment of anticipation.

jobs.title: Screen & document
jobs.when: Showing a real app, page or document the speaker is talking about.
